text:
Maya R: quick share from a 10k bring-up for nova11 (11B) int6 vs int8 on webchat slice. headline: int6 saves ~30% but we see concentrated quality regressions on long-form abstractive outputs. details below.

Jin Park: paste top-line numbers pls.

Maya R: eval-bot summary pasted: cost_delta=-30% (int6 vs int8), QA_acc_delta=-1.6pp, halluc_delta=+2.3pp, p95_latency+15ms, n=10000

Maya R: compact table:
```
variant | cost/1k toks | QA_acc | halluc_rate | p95
nova11-int8 | $0.88 | 83.0% | 2.8% | 210ms
nova11-int6 | $0.62 | 81.4% | 5.1% | 225ms
```

Oliver H: where are hallucinations concentrated?

Maya R: mostly >2k token contexts and abstractive summaries; short Q&A and code are fine (~0.3-0.6pp drop).

Ava: from GTN: we need a recommended rollout + unit-econ.

Jin Park: routing idea: length-based hybrid (len>2000->int8 else int6). sim on our trace gives effective cost_per_1k ~$0.70 -> ~22% savings and net hallucination close to guardrails.

Maya R: unit-econ note (assume avg tokens/req=1.4k): all-int8 per 1M req ~= $1,232; hybrid per 1M req ~= $960; savings ~= $272 / 1M (~22%)

Oliver H: ops asks: need per-variant billing tag, hallucin_metric, p95, and an auto-fallback if halluc_rate >5% sustained 5m.

Jin Park: mitigation options: stronger grounding + reranker. rerank recovers ~1.6pp halluc but adds ~6% unit cost; apply only for longform to limit impact.

Ava: propose canary 5% -> 25% over 2 weeks with those gates and fallback. I can draft GTN blurb.

Maya R: exec blurb draft: "Recommend hybrid rollout: default int6 for short endpoints, pin long-context features to int8. Simulation shows ~22% model cost savings while keeping longform quality near baseline. Start 5% canary, widen to 25% with tight gates (hallucination, QA-slice regressions, p95). Fallback to all-int8 if hallucination exceeds 5% for 5 minutes."

Oliver H: agree. owners: Maya -> upload per-slice CSV and examples; Jin -> smoke harness for canary metrics; Ops -> billing tags + fallback alarm; Ava -> finalize GTN copy.

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval/nova11/3501234567/ (per-slice CSV, sim configs, top failure examples)

Maya R: will upload files and ping when live.

Jin Park: +1, I'll start the harness.

Oliver H: thanks all. if canary triggers, rollback and run brief triage.
